claims.claim_text: Benjamin Rivlin's first-person account confirms his Army assignment to the OSS Research and Analysis Branch.
claims.evidence_excerpt: I found myself assigned to the Africa Section in the Research and Analysis Branch of the Office of Strategic Services
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Rivlin describes his 1943 Army training, recent Brooklyn College graduation, and assignment to Bunche's OSS Africa Section.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by the distinctive exact name, compatible indexed T-4 grade, first-person Army-to-OSS sequence, and Brooklyn College class-year corroboration.
claims.temporal_assessment: The account explicitly places Army training less than six months before assignment to OSS in 1943.
claims.match_notes: No civilian employer is inferred from student or Army status.
